about: One row per entry of the Comanche055 coverage map (acceptance item 2: every major mode and routine the program uses), taken as they are from D1b's /mnt/project-files/acceptance/comanche055-coverage-map.md (130 code-derived rows; host runs on base 08bc7cfb; reviewer 2 ruled the not-exercised rows). status is mapped (scenarios names the tools/flight_host_differential.py FLIGHT entries whose host run reaches the entry), not exercised (note gives the reason) or TBD (a gap with an owner, or mapped only in an open PR). D1b keeps the markdown map; Lane G keeps this file and the C64 results. replay_windows lists the C64 --replay windows (scenario, start cs, length cs, K for a --chain of K windows, checkpoint every cs): one 300 cs window from 50 cs before each mapped row's first arrival in its scenario, merged where one window holds several, plus the two CM chains that held. A row's windows are the ones holding its arrivals. cm-p11 rows use the scenario clock before liftoff; its P11 window starts at 15100, past the AGC clock reset at liftoff.
